discipline: physics derives the lever family; the pinned approved-agent corpus supplies a safe instance; never the reverse. Every candidate is a DIRECTION-only, falsifiable [O] hypothesis carrying a safety annotation and a source -- a lead to test, never a treatment claim. 'Suitable' = mechanism-direction-concordant.

honest_limit: Corpus mechanism annotations are imperfect; a surfaced agent is a direction-matched, safety-known LEAD, not a validated mechanism for the specific fold. BROAD candidates are the weakest tier and may be off-target. No candidate is a treatment; every one is refutable by its falsifier.
join_rule: match family.corrective_mechanism_sign == agent.mechanism_sign; filter by allele scope (residual_only agent requires a residual lesion); filter by specificity (gene_specific/pathway agent must match the disease gene OR carry it in its applies_to_genes downstream allow-list; broad matches any residual-lesion disease); approved-first, strongest specificity first; no tuned weights

surfaced_candidates.falsifier: If eladocagene exuparvovec (a gene-specific supply/increase agent) does NOT move the DOWN [F] switch toward the healthy branch in a DDC-deficient model, the h-restore(supply) direction is refuted for eladocagene exuparvovec here.
surfaced_candidates.mechanism_note: An AAV serotype-2 gene therapy that delivers a functional human DDC gene directly into the putamen, restoring the aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase competence the disease gene cannot provide and re-enabling dopamine and serotonin synthesis. Direction: increase / supply the missing enzymatic competence. Engaged node: DDC -- the agent provides a working copy of the disease gene itself. Allele scope: agnostic -- supplies competence irrespective of the DDC variant. Gene-specific to DDC. Modality: a one-time approved in-vivo gene therapy delivered by stereotactic neurosurgery, not an oral or infused small molecule; the supply direction recovers an approved indication.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Eladocagene exuparvovec (AAV2 gene therapy delivering a functional DDC gene to the putamen) is approved for AADC deficiency; the supply direction recovered an approved indication. One-time gene therapy delivered neurosurgically -- access/delivery barriers remain.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_source: FDA/EMA label: eladocagene exuparvovec (Kebilidi/Upstaza), AADC deficiency
surfaced_candidates.safety_note: intraputaminal neurosurgical delivery; dyskinesia and sleep/behavioural signals on label (qualitative; no magnitude); one-time administration at a specialised centre
source: FDA label: eladocagene exuparvovec-tneq (Kebilidi), AADC deficiency

surfaced_candidates.falsifier: If vosoritide (a pathway decrease agent) clearing/opposing the accumulating load does NOT relieve the DOWN [F] disease branch in a FGFR3 model, the h-restore(clear) direction is refuted for vosoritide here.
surfaced_candidates.mechanism_note: A CNP analogue that activates natriuretic-peptide receptor B (NPR-B) in the growth plate, whose downstream signalling antagonises the over-active FGFR3 pathway driving the gain-of-function achondroplasia phenotype. Direction: decrease / oppose the FGFR3 over-signalling. Engaged node: NPR-B (the agent acts on the receptor that counter-regulates FGFR3, not on FGFR3 itself). Allele scope: agnostic -- counters the pathway downstream of the lesion. Mapped to achondroplasia (a GOF lesion, for which only the decrease / h-restore direction is admissible). An approved agent; the geometry's clear direction recovers it.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Vosoritide is approved for achondroplasia and opposes FGFR3 over-signalling; the clear/decrease direction recovered the approved agent.

surfaced_candidates.falsifier: If givosiran (a pathway decrease agent) clearing/opposing the accumulating load does NOT relieve the UP [F] disease branch in a HMBS model, the h-restore(clear) direction is refuted for givosiran here.

Allele scope: agnostic -- reduces precursor flux regardless of the HMBS variant. Mapped to acute intermittent porphyria. An approved agent; the geometry's clear direction recovers it.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Givosiran is approved for acute hepatic porphyria and lowers the precursors driving AIP attacks; the clear direction recovered the approved agent.

surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Xanthine oxidase inhibition (allopurinol/febuxostat) is the established preventive treatment for 2,8-DHA stones in APRT deficiency; established treatment recovered.

surfaced_candidates.mechanism_note: A use-dependent voltage-gated sodium-channel blocker (Class IB) that damps the repetitive sarcolemmal action potentials (myotonic runs) of the non-dystrophic myotonias. In the chloride-channel form (CLCN1, myotonia congenita) the membrane is hyper-excitable because the ClC-1 chloride conductance is lost; in the sodium-channel form (SCN4A) a gain-of-function persistent Nav1.4 sodium current drives the same hyper-excitability. Direction: decrease / oppose the over-active sodium-current-driven excitability in both. Allele scope: agnostic -- stabilises the membrane and does not require residual channel function. Mapped to both myotonia congenita (CLCN1) and the SCN4A skeletal-muscle channelopathy; some SCN4A genotypes are known to respond less, which the falsifier captures. Deliberately NOT routed to the SCN5A channelopathies (Brugada is loss-of-function, where sodium blockade is contraindicated; long-QT-3 is a separate node). Approved (EU) for non-dystrophic myotonic disorders; the geometry's decrease direction recovers it. A low-cost small molecule.

surfaced_candidates.falsifier: If mexiletine (a pathway decrease agent) clearing/opposing the accumulating load does NOT relieve the UP [F] disease branch in a SCN4A model, the h-restore(clear) direction is refuted for mexiletine here.
surfaced_candidates.mechanism_note: A use-dependent voltage-gated sodium-channel blocker (Class IB) that damps the repetitive sarcolemmal action potentials (myotonic runs) of the non-dystrophic myotonias. In the chloride-channel form (CLCN1, myotonia congenita) the membrane is hyper-excitable because the ClC-1 chloride conductance is lost; in the sodium-channel form (SCN4A) a gain-of-function persistent Nav1.4 sodium current drives the same hyper-excitability. Direction: decrease / oppose the over-active sodium-current-driven excitability in both. Allele scope: agnostic -- stabilises the membrane and does not require residual channel function. Mapped to both myotonia congenita (CLCN1) and the SCN4A skeletal-muscle channelopathy; some SCN4A genotypes are known to respond less, which the falsifier captures. Deliberately NOT routed to the SCN5A channelopathies (Brugada is loss-of-function, where sodium blockade is contraindicated; long-QT-3 is a separate node). Approved (EU) for non-dystrophic myotonic disorders; the geometry's decrease direction recovers it. A low-cost small molecule.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Mexiletine is the licensed/established antimyotonic for non-dystrophic myotonia (the SCN4A sodium-channel disorder); the decrease direction recovered it. Scoped to SCN4A so it is not mis-routed to the loss-of-function SCN5A Brugada node, where sodium blockade is contraindicated.

surfaced_candidates.falsifier: If lovotibeglogene autotemcel (a gene-specific decrease agent) clearing/opposing the accumulating load does NOT relieve the DOWN [F] disease branch in a HBB model, the h-restore(clear) direction is refuted for lovotibeglogene autotemcel here.
surfaced_candidates.mechanism_note: An autologous haematopoietic stem-cell therapy transduced ex vivo with a lentiviral vector encoding an anti-sickling adult beta-globin (HbA-T87Q); the T87Q residue sits at a deoxy-HbS contact and interferes with HbS polymerisation, so red cells carrying the engineered globin sickle far less. Direction on the disease axis: decrease / clear the HbS-polymerisation and sickling drive -- distinct from the fetal-haemoglobin-INDUCTION lever (hydroxyurea and the HbF-editing gene therapies) which is an increase action the corpus surfaces on the beta-thalassaemia node. Engaged node: HBB (the beta-globin locus). Allele scope: agnostic with respect to the sickle variant. Gene-specific to HBB; encoded as a decrease lever and approved for sickle cell disease only, so the join surfaces it on sickle_cell_disease and not on the increase/stabilise beta-thalassaemia node. Modality: a one-time approved ex-vivo gene therapy requiring conditioning, carrying a boxed haematologic-malignancy warning; the decrease direction recovers an approved indication.
surfaced_candidates.prior_art_note: Lovotibeglogene autotemcel (ex-vivo lentiviral anti-sickling HbA-T87Q beta-globin HSC gene therapy) is approved for sickle cell disease with vaso-occlusive events; the engineered anti-sickling globin disrupts HbS polymerisation, which is the disease-axis decrease direction, recovering an approved indication. Encoded as a decrease lever and approved for sickle cell disease only, so it is not surfaced on the beta-thalassaemia node (increase / stabilise). Note: the cornerstone agent hydroxyurea is encoded in the corpus as an HbF-INDUCTION (increase) lever and therefore surfaces on the thalassaemia node, not here -- an honest consequence of the sign convention. Boxed warning for haematologic malignancy; conditioning required; access/cost and current-availability caveats.

surfaced_candidates.safety_note: boxed warning for haematologic malignancy; requires myeloablative conditioning; engraftment and conditioning-related signals (qualitative; no magnitude); specialised centre; one-time administration; access and cost barriers, and current commercial availability should be confirmed
